title: RCP organization-perimeter resource guardrail (aws:PrincipalOrgID Deny)
note: IAM-1302: a deny-only, Principal-bearing org RESOURCE guardrail whose org-scope key is aws:PrincipalOrgID and which carries NO aws:PrincipalIsAWSService signal - so it is an ORGANIZATION-PERIMETER guardrail (guardrailKind 'organization'), not the confused-deputy variant. It denies access to org resources unless the calling principal is within the org. Because the org check is a negated ...IfExists in a Deny, absence of the key STILL denies (fail-closed). No S3/public-access finding, zero capability edges, states RCPs are deny-only and a corresponding Allow must exist elsewhere. Exercises the non-confused-deputy RCP branch.
